name: duckky-swarm
description: Subagents on the exact model you name (Opus 4.6, Opus 5, ...), with proof of the model they ran on, forks, and resume across sessions.

models.title: Subagent models
models.description: name=model-id pairs, comma separated. Each becomes an agent type Claude uses when you ask for that model, e.g. opus-4-6=claude-opus-4-6. Add @effort for its default effort: opus-5-5=claude-opus-5-5@high.

forkMode.title: Fork on another model
forkMode.description: context: a subagent on the chosen model, given a copy of the conversation (works on any model, costs more). true: a real fork, which always stays on the parent's model.

keepAgents.title: Keep subagents across sessions
keepAgents.description: Remember each subagent (its model, task and transcript) after the session ends, so it can be resumed later.

character.title: Character
character.description: Who acts out each subagent's work above the prompt and in the /duckky window: Clawd, or Duckky Ducks (the project's own mascot).

refusalRetries.title: Refusal retries
refusalRetries.description: When a subagent's model refuses, ask the same request again from just before the refused message, up to this many times per subagent; then it stops as refused. 0 turns it off.
